appVersions.name: Dawn Errand · User App
appVersions.sub: Order errands and food delivery, track orders in real time, manage addresses, coupons and reviews

versions.note: Multi-tenant regional rates, order message center, independent pricing for townships / county seats and password-free payment.
Improved identity verification flow, real-time rider location refresh, fewer delivery exceptions.
Coupons and order reviews, revamped address book with smart sorting of frequent addresses.
Fixed Android 12 notification permission compatibility; better ordering experience on weak networks.
First release: ordering / dispatching / tracking / settlement full chain available.

appVersions.name: Dawn Errand · Merchant App
appVersions.sub: Store management, order acceptance and cooking, menu on/off, business status and operating statistics

versions.note: Operating statistics dashboard, cooking-timeout alerts and one-tap export of operating data.
Batch menu on/off, inventory alerts and optimized receipt printing.
Scheduled business-status switching, multi-store switching and visual delivery-fee rules.
Fixed image loading on low-memory devices; upgraded voice alerts for new orders.
First release: store management / order acceptance / order list available.

appVersions.name: Dawn Errand · Rider App
appVersions.sub: Grab and accept orders, delivery navigation, proof of delivery, per-order settlement and daily income details

versions.note: Per-order settlement details and daily income summary; visualized order-acceptance rewards.
Optimized delivery navigation, photo proof of delivery and a refined exception-reporting flow.
Order-grabbing lobby with order filters; one-tap switching between online / busy states.
Voice alerts for new orders and quick order-card actions (accept / deliver / exception).
First release: order grabbing / delivery navigation / per-order settlement available.
